_note: Fan-out Planning Part 2 STEP B — theme×mechanic compatibility layer (EN architecture). Property-table model (Part-1 ruling): per-theme booleans + per-mechanic required-properties + override whitelist, NOT a 50x29 matrix. Booleans firmed from the image-library read (2026-06-06) where it settled them (music=instruments=countable; occupations=people=countable; space=discrete objects; bakery/breakfast=discrete images, collective risk is copy-level only) + EN pedagogical judgment for the abstract set. PER-LOCALE booleans (collective_risk/phonetic_variety partly language-dependent) are a WAVE deliverable, not authored here. Gated set = count/sum/size mechanics only; readiness-class + letter/sort/match/path/pattern route around.

_default._src: default (concrete discrete objects — the catalog norm per image-library pattern)

emotions._src: read: angry/bored/capricious = abstract states, not summable

colors._src: read: color swatches = attributes; chart-count override applies

activities._src: read: baking/baseball/basketball = activities/verbs, not summable objects

body_parts._src: discrete images but summing ears is meaningless (the pilot catch)

music._src: read CORRECTION: accordion/cymbals/drum = discrete instruments = countable (was guessed invalid)

occupations._src: read: actor/architect = discrete people = countable (was guessed risky)

shapes._src: countable; chart-count override; weak phonetic onset variety

bakery._src: read: bagel/baguette discrete; copy must say 'two bagels' not 'a tray of buns'

breakfast._src: read: apple/bacon/bagel discrete; copy collective risk (a stack of pancakes)

miscellaneous._src: grab-bag of discrete objects (key/button/umbrella) = countable; VALID but low-SEO-value (no search demand for 'miscellaneous worksheet') — deprioritize, do not block

_gateRules.countability: INVALID if theme.discrete_countable === false (unless override-whitelisted for this mechanic). WARN if theme.collective_risk (and enforce the copy partitive-noun check).
_gateRules.phonetic: WARN (not block) if theme.phonetic_variety === false (weak onset variety).
_gateRules.readiness: no theme gate — all themes valid (matching/assembly/maze/route over a single image). Readiness-class JSON-LD profile (no educationalAlignment; teaches = readiness strand).
